My sound

House first, Desi at heart. I play from my vibe. That means a proper house and techno foundation, and then the songs I grew up with, remixed for the dancefloor. If a Hindi or Bangla vocal drops over a house groove and the room lights up, that is my set.

House

Groovy, warm and danceable. The backbone of every set. This is what gets people moving early and keeps them there.

Techno

When the night goes later and darker, I push it harder. Driving beats, longer blends, more energy.

Bangla and Bollywood remixes

My signature. Familiar Hindi and Bangla songs rebuilt as house tracks. People know the words, but they have never danced to them like this.

Requests

I play my own vibe and I do not take song requests on demand. If you request a song, it goes in the queue. You will have to wait, and I will play it when it fits the set and goes well with the song I am playing.

My setup

One deck, two monitors, and a lot of passion. Everything you hear in the reels is played on this. It is the only gear I own, and I know it well because every reel is filmed on it.

What I own

  • DeckAlphaTheta XDJ-AZ
  • TypeAll in one DJ system
  • MonitorsPioneer VM-50, a pair
  • CameraPOV glasses
  • StyleHouse and Techno
  • RemixesHindi and Bangla
  • BaseGTA, Canada

The XDJ-AZ is a full standalone deck, so what I play at home is close to what a club booth feels like. The VM-50 monitors keep the mix honest at home and work well for a small house party. They are not a big club sound system, and clubs have their own sound.

I own only the XDJ-AZ player and the VM-50 speakers. I do not have a flight case, fog, lighting or PA speakers. I prefer venues that have their own DJ player. If my own XDJ-AZ is used, I charge more for bringing it. In the worst case I can carry it in the original box it came with.

About, straight up

I would rather be clear now than be the wrong DJ for your night. I play my vibe. If that vibe fits your room, we will have a great night.

My story

I came to Canada in 2013, and I really wanted to be a DJ. I got my first gigs back then. I played Halloween parties, Hindi Halloween nights with good remixes, and some wedding DJ gigs too. Back in those days we had fun, and that is where it all started for me.

Then I stopped. More and more of the work coming my way was wedding DJ work, and that meant playing requested songs all night. That is not how I play, so I stepped away and took a break.

Now I am back at it in my own way. I DJ at home, for passion, and that is where my reels come from, filmed at my own decks. If someone wants to pay me for a small party, I am happy to do it. I have been DJing for about ten years now, on and off. I know my stuff and I know my sound, I do good mixing, and I can keep the vibe going for a long time. I am a passionate DJ. That is the honest way to put it.

I have played live for small crowds of about 15 to 20 people. Honest version for venues and promoters: I do not have a long mixtape yet. My short reels are my demo. They show my mixing, my sound and my vibe in under a minute, and I am building a better portfolio with more remixes and mixtapes. Most of my clips are filmed from my glasses, so you see the deck the way I see it while I play. That is the closest thing to standing in the booth with me.

Away from the decks, I am learning video game development full time at Humber College. That is a small part of my story. This page is about the music.

I am looking for warm up slots, open decks nights and small rooms in the GTA where this sound fits, part time.

“I play from my vibe, house, techno, and the Hindi and Bangla remixes that are my type of tune.”

What I do, and how I play

Good fit for me

  • +Clubs, bars and lounges that want house and techno
  • +Desi nights where Bangla and Bollywood remixes will land
  • +House parties and student nights with a crowd that wants to dance
  • +Small parties and private parties where people are there for the music
  • +Warm up, opening and small room slots. Crowds around 15 to 20 are my level right now, and I am happy to earn bigger rooms over time

How I play

  • +I play my own vibe. I read the room and build the set as I go, so the music flows and the vibe stays up
  • +Requests go in the queue. I do not play songs on demand. If you request a song, you will have to wait, and I will play it when it fits the set and goes well with the song I am playing

* I play small parties and private parties.

Booking

You can reach me from this page in two ways. Send me a DM on Instagram, or send me an email. This page does not have its own inbox, so your message will land in my Instagram or my email inbox.

Send me a message

The fastest way is a DM on Instagram: @md.muntasir.khan. You can also email me at bd.rk94@gmail.com. Copy this message, paste it into a DM or an email, and fill in your details. It tells me everything I need in one go.

Hi Muntasir, I saw your DJ page. I am booking for [venue / party name] on [date] in [city / area]. We want house / techno / Desi remixes for about [how long]. Is that a fit and are you free?

DM on InstagramEmail me

Available part time for small gigs that fit the sound on this page.
